meta.name: grand-slam-offer
meta.description: Design irresistible affiliate offers using the Hormozi Grand Slam framework. Triggers on: "create an offer for", "design my offer", "grand slam offer", "make an irresistible offer", "why should someone buy through my link", "offer framework", "value proposition for", "Hormozi offer", "offer stack", "make my offer irresistible", "craft an offer", "what makes my offer different", "offer design", "increase perceived value".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用框架设计高转化率的联盟营销优惠
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你的联盟链接更具吸引力、提高转化率
copy.tagline_en: Design high-converting affiliate offers using a proven framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to make your affiliate links more irresistible and boost conversions

howto.what: 分析你的联盟营销产品，使用Hormozi价值等式（梦想结果×可信度÷时间延迟÷努力成本）评估，设计包括独特角度、奖金、保证和文案的不可抗拒offer包，以提升转化率。
howto.when: 当你提到“创建offer”、“设计我的offer”等关键词，或要求进行offer设计时触发。也适用于已有产品需要定位。

say.text: 帮我为HeyGen设计一个Grand Slam offer。
say.note: Claude会研究产品并输出完整offer框架。

say.text: 我的Semrush推广转化率低，分析原因并改进offer。
say.note: Claude会评估价值等式并建议优化。

say.text: 基于之前的产品数据，帮我设计offer。

howto.what_en: Analyzes your affiliate product using the Hormozi Value Equation (Dream Outcome × Perceived Likelihood ÷ Time Delay ÷ Effort & Sacrifice), then designs an irresistible offer stack including unique angle, bonuses, guarantee, and copy to boost conversions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "create an offer", "design my offer", "why would someone buy through my link", or ask for offer design. Also applies when positioning an existing product.

say_en.text: Design a Grand Slam offer for HeyGen.
say_en.note: Claude researches the product and outputs a full offer framework.

say_en.text: My Semrush promotion has low conversion, analyze and improve the offer.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates the value equation and suggests optimizations.

say_en.text: Design an offer based on previous product data.
say_en.note: If affiliate-program-search was run earlier, data is reused automatically.
